decisions.reason: Builds directly on existing door-handle expertise and in-house manufacturing, allowing the firm to interpret early results and improve it.
Mitred handle family extends the firm's metalworking and design knowledge, so early results can be assimilated and used for refinement.
Multifunctional handle remains within the firm's architectural hardware competence, enabling learning from market feedback despite added complexity.
Generic door lever handle is closely related to existing products and manufacturing capabilities, so the firm can interpret and act on results.
Award-winning door and window handle collection shows strong market acceptance and builds on core design and engineering strengths, reinforcing the decision to keep.
Light patinated bronze finish leverages the firm's proprietary finishing expertise, making it easy to assimilate feedback and improve the finish.
